current.text: Portland re-signed him for 3 years and 44 million USD.
He is the backup center behind Donovan Clingan.
He is not expected to start over Clingan, although his new contract shows the team trusts him.
He is expected to be capped at 17 to 18 minutes a night and to sit about 16 back-to-backs.
At about 23 minutes a night he would be a draftable player in category leagues.
His 2P% of 74 last season is expected to fall to about 68, which would cut into his FG% value.
Portland has three back-to-backs in the fantasy playoffs.

durable.text: His minutes and his health are hard to trust.
Blocks are his standout category, far above the top 250 pool.
He makes almost no threes and scores few points.
Most of his FG% value comes from twos.
